rules.text: Every realization binds exactly one capability to exactly one realizer for a valid interval; accountablePartyRef is not a realizer.
Capability and realizer identities remain externally mastered.
Transfer closes the predecessor and opens a successor; prior accountability is never rewritten.
Transferred, superseded and ended have disjoint triggers; terminal states require validTo.
Coverage share, when asserted, carries value, basis, denominator and its own period.
Concurrent shares on one denominator reconcile or carry an explicit overlap justification.
Coverage and fullness are derived claims over a scoped as-of binding set and are never fields of BusinessCapability.
A system is only a supporting realizer and cannot alone establish full realization under any evidence grade.
Evidence references pin digest, digest algorithm and criterion; absence of an approved sufficiency rule blocks fullness claims.
Missing bindings remain unknown unless a scoped completeness assertion names population, scope, as-of, asserter and method.
Actual and scenario bindings are explicitly discriminated; scenario bindings never feed authoritative actuals.
Capacity is period-scoped and admissible from WM-ACT-001 only for agent-kind realizers.
Multiple realizations of one capability may coexist.
Assessment and observation identities remain external immutable records.
Valid time and knowledge time are distinct; corrections append knowledge-time successors rather than rewriting facts.
Ended realizations retain tombstones and remain resolvable for historical coverage and assessment.
